title: •Organa’s Ceremonial Necklace
caption: •Organa’s Ceremonial Necklace (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove those cards (except with Grimtaash). May lose 2 Force to target two {set:coruscant} Political Effects; opponent may not place cards on either until the next time you use this text. {alter}
lore: Necklace worn by Princess Leia during the awards ceremony after the Battle of Yavin. A powerful artifact in the Alderaanian royal family for dozens of generations.

notes: Group: Everything else (sheet page 'Virtual Set 16: Everything else', DARK SIDE). Unique (•). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box (printed base is a Premiere Utinni Effect). Inline icon before 'Political Effects' = pink/lavender sphere with yellow rim = the Coruscant expansion symbol → {set:coruscant}; the stub drops it. Game text ends with the red circle-slash A → {alter} (stub 'Immune to Alter.'). Curly apostrophe in the title/caption 'Organa’s'. STUB DISCREPANCY: the stub has destiny=6, but the printed card's destiny is 4 (wiki base page and scan) and the slip does not print a destiny — kept 4. Lore matches the scan. Premiere: no expansion ring. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright not legible — Premiere 1995 line per the brief. Modern: VB1 -pre (350) only.
